title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy interventions, information exposure, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: SocialInfluence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among their network neighbors and update their adoption probability via social proof and conformity bias.

interactions.name: ObservationalNormsInLocations
interactions.description: Visibility of mask use within a location shifts perceived norms and affects immediate compliance and future adoption.

interactions.name: PolicyMandate
interactions.description: A mandate increases the utility of wearing masks via compliance pressure and potential fines; effects depend on trust and enforcement level.

interactions.name: Enforcement
interactions.description: Active enforcement at locations or by authorities results in warnings or fines for non-compliance, modifying future behavior.

interactions.name: InformationExposure
interactions.description: People receive messages from media and campaigns that update risk perception, trust, and misinformation belief levels.

interactions.name: MaskAcquisition
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to purchase masks; success depends on retailer inventory, price, and rationing policies.

interactions.name: HouseholdInfluenceAndSharing
interactions.description: Household members influence each other’s adoption and can share mask stock when supply is scarce.

interactions.name: OptionalDiseaseTransmission
interactions.description: If enabled, mask wearing reduces transmission probability during contacts; infection prevalence feeds back into risk perception.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_threshold
metrics.description: Days required to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: steady_state_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final evaluation window indicating persistence.

metrics.name: de_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which previously compliant individuals stop wearing masks.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality
metrics.description: Variance or Gini index of adoption across demographic groups or network communities.

metrics.name: location_compliance
metrics.description: Average fraction of visitors wearing masks by location type (workplace, transit, retail).

metrics.name: stockout_days
metrics.description: Number of days with retailer stockouts in the system.

metrics.name: purchases_per_capita
metrics.description: Average number of masks purchased per person over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: policy_efficiency
metrics.description: Increase in adoption per unit policy cost (e.g., fines issued, campaign spend).

metrics.name: optional_cases_averted
metrics.description: If disease dynamics are enabled, estimated cases averted due to mask adoption.
